description: Schema contract for anonymized field failure replay sample series. The manifest stores series metadata, not raw customer image paths.
redactionRules: Raw customer filesystem paths are forbidden.
Sample ids must be hashed or synthetic identifiers.
Images may be stored only in approved anonymized fixture packs.
Reports may include metrics and taxonomy labels, not customer names, site names, serial numbers, or order identifiers.

slaRules.stableDrillDefinition: Three consecutive passing drills with reproducible rate >= 80%, regressionized rate >= 60%, and zero privacy/path leaks.
